description: After the user pays a card checkout link (pay_with_card), Stripe shows a receipt page whose link contains /v1/orders/ and session_id=. Pass that full link as order_url to get the paid records. Results stay available for 24 hours after payment. Leftover credit can be turned into a reusable API key via the claim_key_url in the result.

order_url.description: The receipt page link shown after paying the card checkout, e.g. https://data.truefixr.com/v1/orders/ord_.../?session_id=cs_...

name: get_paid_order
title: Fetch a paid card order
